Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 20, 2026. This policy is a starting-point template and should be reviewed by qualified counsel before launch.

What we collect

When you request a property analysis, contact us, join our email list, or use one of our tools, we collect what you submit: name, phone, email, city, project details, an optional property address, and any files you upload. We also collect basic technical data such as pages visited and the marketing source (UTM parameters) that brought you to the site.

How we use it

We use your information to respond to your request, schedule a property analysis, prepare estimates, and follow up about your project. If you join the email list we may send occasional ADU tips; you can unsubscribe at any time.

Analytics and cookies

If analytics or advertising tags are enabled, they load only after you accept. You can change your choice at any time by clearing this site's storage in your browser.

Sharing

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers who help us run the website, email and scheduling, and with financing or permitting partners when you ask us to involve them.

Retention and your choices

We keep project inquiries as long as needed to serve you and meet legal obligations. To access, correct or delete your information, email admin@adu-america.com.
